sections.title: Create Expert Panel 1: Exam Questions Review

prompts.text:
Compile a panel of 10 people with diverse specialist competencies, personality types, and challenges that I can use as a sounding board for feedback on exam questions I write in biology and natural science. The panel's feedback should support high validity and reliability, whether the exam question is used on its own or bundled with others, so that it can be used to assess students' knowledge and understanding.

Since I want the virtual participants' traits to be grounded in relevant knowledge and skills, I am using Deep Research so Gemini first gathers and compiles relevant information before it presents the finished report that will form the basis for the expert panel.
prompts.notes: Use Deep Research for this prompt. Takes 5-10 minutes.

prompts.text: Compile a panel of 10 people with diverse specialist competencies, personality types, and challenges that I can use as a sounding board for feedback on the email draft I attach. Consider what is known about email construction, language, audience, and tone. The expert panel must discuss and compromise and, if needed, ask me one brief clarifying question at a time before giving short, clear, and relevant improvement suggestions.
prompts.notes: Use Deep Research for this prompt. Start while Panel 1 is running.
